thread:
incident-bot: PAGE to @oncall: dedicated-pool node anomaly detected - Mariner Systems (VPC: vpc-mariner-1). GPU node gpu-node-77 (pool: mariner-dedpool) reporting repeated ECC and thermal interrupts, autoscaler triggers observed. Severity: P1.

Anna C (oncall): Got the page — I'm on it. Can someone post the short runbook link? I'll collect initial triage. :mag:  

Ryan K (eng-sre): Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-gpu-node-failure. TL;DR: isolate tenant, set pool to drain, attempt live-migrate workloads, if migrate fails then cordon+replace.

Priya M (eng-runtime): Adding logs from runtime: 
```
[2026-03-15T01:02:13Z] gpu-node-77: ECC_ERROR_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED
[2026-03-15T01:03:01Z] nvlink: link-flap-retry=6
[2026-03-15T01:04:22Z] tdr: thermal-throttle(temp=92C)
```
We see thermal + ECC bursts. Likely hardware degradation. Live migration attempts are failing with stuck KV cache on some sessions.

Anna C (oncall): Customer-facing triage: @Sam T can you confirm Mariner escalation path? Do they want immediate failover or planned maintenance window?

Sam T (acct): Chatted with Mariner Support — they want minimal impact, prefer in-place fix if <30m. If we need longer, they require 15-min heads up and routing of requests to backup pool. Contact: ops@mariner.example.

Sophie L (solutions): Noted. Mariner has latency-sensitive realtime inferencing routes pinned to mariner-dedpool. We should avoid routing all traffic to shared hosting; use their standby pool mariner-dedpool-2 (warm) with capacity for most traffic but lower priority models.

Ryan K (eng-sre): Plan: 1) Mark gpu-node-77 as DRAIN -> cordon new tasks 2) Trigger live-migrate with migrate-tool --node gpu-node-77 --timeout 120 3) If >2 failures or >15m of retries, evict remaining workloads to mariner-dedpool-2 via route-policy set.

Anna C (oncall): Executing step 1 now. Command: `redwoodctl node drain --node gpu-node-77 --pool mariner-dedpool`

incident-bot: ACTION: node drain job 11892 queued by Anna C. Estimated ETA: 30s.

Priya M (eng-runtime): Live-migrate attempt 1: `migrate-tool` returned 8/12 sessions migrated, 4 sessions stuck on KV cache flush. Reattempting with `--force-cache-flush`.

Anna C (oncall): Reattempting with force. If this doesn't finish in 5m, we'll start route-policy change and notify customer.

Hardware-ops: FYI we pulled BMC logs; PCIe lane 3 shows repeated AER resets and voltage droop history. Looks like imminent card failure. We should prepare a replacement GPU and plan BMC cold-reboot if live-migrate unsuccessful.

Priya M (eng-runtime): Reattempt fail: `migrate-tool` timed out after 120s. 3 sessions still pinned, manual eviction required. Some sessions show persistent KV mismatch.

Anna C (oncall): Ok moving to fallback. Changing routing for Mariner: `routectl set-policy --tenant mariner --from mariner-dedpool --to mariner-dedpool-2 --percent 100 --reason "node failure"`

incident-bot: POLICY UPDATE applied. Traffic for mariner now routed to mariner-dedpool-2. Expected cutover time: <30s.

Mariner Support (customer): Confirming we see 503 spike then steady failover to backup pool. Thanks for the heads up. Please advise ETA for replacement.

Sophie L (solutions): Observed increased latency on some endpoints during migration (~450ms -> 1.2s). Most requests are healthy now on mariner-dedpool-2. Continue replacement plan.

Anna C (oncall): Notifying Hardware-ops to schedule hot-swap. @Hardware-ops can you perform BMC cold-reboot and if no improvement, swap GPU card? We're blocking the node from scheduling until confirmed.

Hardware-ops: Initiating BMC cold-reboot now. Command run: `ipmitool -H gpu-node-77-bmc -I lanplus chassis power cycle`. Requesting 4m for boot + health checks.

Priya M (eng-runtime): After reboot logs: temp stabilized to 45C but ECC counters continue to increment on startup. ECC error count increased by +42 post-reboot. Not safe to return to rotation.

Hardware-ops: Confirmed hardware evidences. Plan: decommission card, replace GPU unit. ETA for field swap in our DC: 3.5 hours (replacement parts on site).

Sam T (acct): Mariner accepts replacement window but wants rolling failback when proven. They requested a 15-min notice before we move traffic back to original pool.

Anna C (oncall): Notes/next steps: - Node gpu-node-77 remains cordoned/drained. - Traffic on mariner handled by mariner-dedpool-2. - Hardware replacement scheduled (3.5h). - Post-swap, we'll run soak tests with synthetic traces for 30m, then coordinate with Sam for 15m heads-up and switchback.

Priya M (eng-runtime): Creating post-incident ticket with logs and metrics. Metrics snapshot: 
```
GPU ECC error rate: 0 -> 42 (post-reboot)
Thermal max observed: 92C
Failed live-migrate attempts: 2
Evicted sessions: 12
```
Ticket: #INC-3076543210-REPLACE-GPU.

Anna C (oncall): Closing incident channel for immediate mitigation. Will reopen for replacement window and post-mortem. Thanks all — good coordination. :white_check_mark:

Mariner Support (customer): Thank you team. Please include us on the switchback notification. ops@mariner.example on distribution list.

incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 -> mitigated (traffic moved to backup pool). Follow-up: schedule RCA and postmortem within 48h.
